configurations.name: rapporter-server
runtimeArgs: import os, http.server, socketserver; from functools import partial; DIR = '/private/tmp'; os.chdir(DIR); handler = partial(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, directory=DIR); port = int(os.environ.get('PORT', 8000)); print(f'Serving {DIR} on http://localhost:{port}/', flush=True); socketserver.TCPServer(('', port), handler).serve_forever()
